claims.claim: FastAPI with one uvicorn worker typically idles at a few tens of MB
claims.measured: 40 MB idle memory; 41–47 MB peak across all tests
claims.why: The measured idle figure of 40 MB is exactly 'a few tens of MB'.

claims.claim: It fits in 512 MB; at a few requests a minute you'll never be near the limit
claims.measured: Peak memory 41–47 MB even under heavy load (up to 256 connections)
claims.why: Even under far heavier load than a few requests a minute, peak memory stayed below 10% of 512 MB.

claims.claim: Go is excellent for small memory footprints
claims.measured: 2 MB idle; 7–16 MB peak across tests
claims.why: Go servers are among the smallest in memory measured, below every Python, Node, JVM and PHP server.

claims.claim: Django is powerful but heavy for three or four endpoints
claims.why: Django was not among the servers measured.
